comment: Mechatronics (team 13368, STEP export ROBOT 13368). Coordinates are in the CAD frame (meters, Z up, front = -X, left = -Y). Parts are matched in order: the first rule that fits a CAD part wins. The turret (Assembly 1 <2>) turns on a 4" X-contact bearing, driven by two servos through its 127-tooth ring gear. A 72 mm Rhino wheel at the turret's front, turned by a motor on each side, throws the ball up along the hood behind it (set by a servo through the 247-tooth sector, about the flywheel's axle) and forward over its top. The intake is a shaft of three flexible stars with a vectored intake wheel at each end; 2" compliant wheels then carry balls back up the curved ramp under them, and the last pair (transfer) pushes them up through the turret's ring. The CAD has a left-slant wheel at the front right too, so its rollers are set to lean like the back left one's. The number plates (Part 13, 19, 23) are left out: the game puts its alliance signs in their holders.
